description: Software development, IT services, system integration, web development, IT support, SaaS, cloud services, mobile apps, DevOps
typical_workflows: Requirements engineering: Capture and document customer requirements
Development: Coding, code reviews, testing, refactoring, pair programming
DevOps: CI/CD, deployment, monitoring, maintenance, infrastructure-as-code
Support: Ticket handling, bug fixes, updates, incident management
Documentation: Technical docs, API docs, user guides, architecture diagrams
Project management: Sprints, stand-ups, retrospectives, backlog grooming
Customer support: Status updates, demos, training, onboarding
Security: Vulnerability scans, penetration tests, security reviews, compliance audits
Code quality: Linting, static analysis, code coverage, technical debt management
common_pain_points: Documentation neglected: Time pressure leads to missing docs and technical debt
Code reviews slow: Bottleneck at senior developers, delayed releases
Testing time-consuming: Unit tests, integration tests, E2E tests, regressions
Support consumes development time: Tickets interrupt flow, context switching
Knowledge silos: Knowledge only in individual heads, bus-factor risk
Technical debt: No time for refactoring, legacy code problems
Recruiting difficult: Skills shortage in IT, long onboarding times
Security compliance: GDPR, ISO 27001, SOC2 requirements, AI Act
ai_opportunities: Code generation: Boilerplate, tests, documentation via Copilot/GPT
Code review assistance: Automatic review suggestions, security checks
Documentation generation: Code to automatic API docs/README/changelogs
Bug analysis: Log analysis, root cause analysis, suggest causes
Test generation: Automatically create unit tests from code, edge cases
Ticket summarization: Categorize, prioritize, route support tickets
Meeting minutes: Automatically document sprint reviews, action items
Requirements extraction: Customer email to structured user stories
Architecture analysis: Visualize code dependencies, refactoring suggestions
DevOps automation: Generate infrastructure-as-code, deployment scripts
typical_tools: VS Code / JetBrains IDEs for development
Git/GitHub/GitLab for version control and CI/CD
Jira / Linear / Asana for project management
Docker / Kubernetes for containers and orchestration
AWS / Azure / GCP / Vercel for cloud hosting
Sentry / Datadog for monitoring and error tracking
typical_data_sources: Git repositories: Code, commits, pull requests, issues
Project management: Tickets, sprints, burndowns, velocity
Monitoring logs: Error logs, performance metrics, uptime
CI/CD pipelines: Build times, test results, deployment frequency
Support tickets: Customer inquiries, bug reports, feature requests
API metrics: Response times, error rates, usage statistics

success_metrics: Velocity: Story points per sprint, trend over time
Bug rate: Bugs per release, critical bugs in production
Deployment frequency: Releases per week/month, lead time
MTTR: Mean time to recovery for incidents
Code coverage: Percent tested code, coverage trend
PR cycle time: Time from PR creation to merge
Customer satisfaction: NPS, support ticket resolution time
